site_name: Amazon Data Services Olson Rd site, 100 SE Olson Road, Boardman, OR 97818
verification: The deck (opened and read slide by slide) confirms the researcher's quote, but the only dated facts are an agreement year (2018) and the first exemption year (2020). Neither is an opening, commissioning, certificate-of-occupancy, or year-built statement, so 2019 remains the researcher's inference. The Hermiston annual report I opened does show the 'certificate of occupancy in year N, exemption in year N+1' pattern for PDX138 (July 2024 then 2025), but that is a different enterprise zone and county; no page I opened states the rule for Morrow County's zone or applies it to Olson Rd. If that rule held, the supported year would be 2019, but this is inference, not verified. The deck carries no explicit date (it reports collections 'As of March 20', which I read as March 2025; uncertain). An EPA Facility Registry query for Amazon in Boardman returned four Amazon Data Services records (Gar Swanson Rd, Lewis & Clark Dr, Bombing Range Rd, Rippee Rd) and none on Olson Rd, so the address tie could not be strengthened.

lead.year_evidence_quote: The Olson Rd agreement was finalized in 2018 and began its exemption in 2020.
lead.notes: The Morrow County Assessor's 2024-25 property tax presentation to the City of Boardman (opened, text extracted) names an Amazon 'Olson Rd' enterprise-zone site whose exemption began in 2020, with payments 'per building or data center'. I infer first operation in 2019, on the assumption that the exemption starts the year after the property goes into service. Hermiston's PDX138 fits that pattern (certificate of occupancy July 2024, exemption began 2025), but the rule itself is not verified. The tie to 100 SE Olson Road is also inference, since the deck gives no street number and directories place the campus at 79386 Olson Rd. Treat this as a lead, not a date.

site_name: Amazon Data Services PDX138, 972 E. Penney Avenue, Hermiston, OR 97838
year_evidence_quote: It received a Certificate of Occupancy in July 2024 and is operational.
year_site_match: The City of Hermiston page names the facility as Amazon's first campus, PDX138. The tie to 972 E. Penney Avenue comes from cross-referencing other records I opened, not from the city page: the EPA Facility Registry lists a facility literally named 'PDX 138' at 994 E Penny Ave, Hermiston (stormwater construction permit ORR10H664, registry 110071660794) at the same mapped point (45.81322, -119.26713) as its 'Amazon Data Services, Inc.' record at 972 E Penny Ave (registry 110071854398, ICIS-Air status 'Operating'). The Jan 25, 2024 Trinity Consultants letter to Oregon DEQ (permit 30-0123) places PDX138 generators at UTM 11N 323,906 E / 5,075,207 N, which I converted to about 45.808, -119.266, roughly 0.6 km south of that point, consistent with one campus.
verification: Year 2024 supported at medium confidence: a city government page gives a July 2024 certificate of occupancy for the named facility and says it is operational. The city's Greater Hermiston Enterprise Zone Manager's Annual Report 2025 (dated August 2026, opened) corroborates: PDX138 'broke ground in 2023, and received its first Certificate of Occupancy in July, 2024', with 2025 the first exemption year. Kept at medium, not high, for two reasons. First, the dated event is a certificate of occupancy; the page says 'is operational' as of an undated page (it references end-2025 and November 2025 payments, so it was written in 2026) and does not state the month operations began. Second, no single page names 972 E Penney Ave as PDX138; the tie rests on the EPA registry placing 'PDX 138' (994 E Penny Ave) and Amazon Data Services (972 E Penny Ave; ECHO's ICIS-Air entry shows 908 E Penney Ave) at the same coordinates, plus the DEQ letter coordinates. I could not locate the second campus, PDX245, so I cannot rule out from these pages that it also sits on E Penney Ave; the same-point EPA records and the 'Operating' air status favor PDX138. The DEQ permit PDF host (deq.state.or.us) returned an expired-certificate error and was not opened. Both Hermiston pages agree PDX245 had no certificate of occupancy by end-2025.
